identity_and_scope.principle: Hierarchy, family and State can be culturally salient while loyalty, guilt, cruelty and political alignment remain individual/stateful.

misread_risks: Institutional confidence is not proof of cruelty.
Suspicion or caution is not proof of guilt.
Occupation-era history does not assign personal responsibility to every Cardassian.

rules: State loyalty is not implied by species.
Military rank and civilian/state authority are separate.
Family reputation can influence social context only when actual family state exists.

family_kinship_and_household.known_context: family and parental authority can carry cultural weight
rules: Kinship must come from persistent family graph.
Family duty does not automatically equal affection or obedience.
Do not invent relatives or family rivalries for drama.

work_service_and_profession.rule: Species does not imply military, intelligence or state employment.

law_duty_and_obligation.rule: Actual legal obligation comes from era/campaign institutions, not culture alone.

cross_cultural_interaction.professional_response: Separate historical context from individual biography, legal responsibility and present loyalty.

notes: Occupation, withdrawal from Bajor, Klingon invasion, Dominion alignment and resistance radically change social/political context across the 2370s.

ai_guardrails: Do not make every Cardassian cruel, authoritarian or deceptive.
Do not assign occupation guilt without individual history.
Do not invent family/state obligations without provenance.
Do not confuse cultural hierarchy with automatic legal authority.
